'''Baisong''' is a Teacher NPC found in {{Location|Jinzhou}}, Jinzhou Institute, found upstairs above the Jinzhou Theater stage. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Baisong:''' Children. One by one. Take your time. No need to rush.
:'''Baisong:''' Let's start with [[Xinxin]]. What does Xinxin want to show the teacher?
:'''Xinxin:''' Mr. Bosong! I finished my essay! I'm the first again!
:'''Baisong:''' Good work, Xinxin. You always finish fast. I'll read them carefully.
:'''Baisong:''' What about [[Lil. Ling|Ling'er]]? How's her essay coming along? Xinxin said before that Ling'er liked being alone and didn't seem to talk to everyone.
:'''Baisong:''' So, if you encounter any difficulties, or if you have something that you don't understand or don't know who to share with, you can pen a letter to Ms. Yuyi. Sounds good?

;(Talk to Baisong again)
:'''Baisong:''' Well. When it comes to Ling'er...
:'''Baisong:''' She doesn't like to talk and likes to keep things to herself. Her parents passed away while she was young and there's no one to take care of her.
:'''Baisong:''' Yuyi's used to worry for Ling'er the most. During the holidays, she always asked me about how's Ling'er doing in school and in life.
:'''Baisong:''' She said that she loved these children the most, and always worried about if they were healthy and getting the stuff they needed.
:'''Baisong:''' When she left, she entrusted these children to me, but I could never be as thoughtful as she is. I really don't know if I can take care of them well... sigh...

;(Talk to Baisong once again)
:'''Baisong:''' Alright, children, it's time for class. Please be quiet.
:'''Baisong:''' You may play all you want after class. But during class, please listen carefully.
:'''Baisong:''' If you ever catch yourself snoozing off. It's okay. You can stand up for a while to keep yourself awake. Learning requires patience. We can take it slow, okay?
----
;<nowiki>18:00-05:59 at Jinhzou Institute</nowiki>
;(During the evening)
:'''Baisong:''' Oh, these kids... I wonder what Yuyi would do if she were here...
:{{DIcon}} Who's this Yuyi?
:'''Baisong:''' Ah, you're still here. Yuyi... She's my lover...
:'''Baisong:''' Both she and I attended this school. After she had graduated, she became a teacher. She had always treated these students as her children.
:'''Baisong:''' She's a great teacher, but fate can be cruel... Now, I just want to fulfill her last wish and help these children grow up well.
:'''Baisong:''' I wonder if these children will remember Ms. Yuyi when they grow up...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
* His name shows '''Bosong''', but interacting changes to '''Baisong'''.
